svg.title: Check the plan before a coding agent edits files
svg.desc: A plan lets a reviewer check what the agent intends to change and how the team will test it. Read. Have the agent inspect the rule in the practice project. Plan. Identify the allowed edit and cases that would show the rule works. Approve and test. Review the plan, then inspect the edit and run those cases.
